speaker: Patient
text: Newborn, female. The patient is a 3000-g (6.6-lb) female newborn delivered at term to a 23-year-old primigravida mother. The mother reports having had no prenatal care, and immunization records for the newborn are not available.

speaker: Doctor
text: Thank you. Since there was no prenatal care, was the mother's syphilis status known or tested at delivery? Please describe any specific physical findings, particularly regarding the skin, eyes, or skeletal system.

speaker: Patient
text: My main symptom is Continuous heart murmur. I also have Bluish macules on the skin that do not blanch with pressure, Cloudy lenses in both eyes noticed upon examination, Failure to pass auditory screening tests.

speaker: Doctor
text:
The combination of a continuous heart murmur, non-blanching bluish macules (likely purpura), cataracts, and hearing loss is highly suggestive of Congenital Rubella Syndrome.

Was the mother vaccinated against rubella, or do you recall if she had a rash or fever during the first trimester of pregnancy?

REQUEST TEST: Rubella_IgM

speaker: Doctor
text:
The positive Rubella IgM test confirms the suspicion of a congenital rubella infection.
DIAGNOSIS READY: Congenital Rubella Syndrome
